items.title: 01 · THE MONOLITH
items.description: One thick matte-black hexagon block, a thin neon inner hexagon, the P raised big in the middle. Light: Neon edge lines that slowly breathe.

items.title: 02 · NESTED FRAMES
items.description: Three open chrome hexagon frames floating one behind the other. No plate: you see straight through. Light: Blue backlight glowing through the frames.

items.title: 03 · GLASS HIVE
items.description: Seven honeycomb cells: six frosted-glass cells round one solid cell holding the P. Light: Ice-cyan light lines inside the glass.

items.title: 04 · CHROME GEM
items.description: A cut-gem chrome hexagon with big angled facets, a black hexagon set in the middle. Light: Red light from underneath, catching the facets.

items.title: 05 · THE ZIGGURAT
items.description: Three hexagon steps stacked like a temple, PEPTICITY on the bottom step, the P on top. Light: Each step’s riser glows ultraviolet, in turn.

items.title: 06 · RELIEF FIELD
items.description: A field of small honeycomb cells at different heights, one big cell rising from the centre with the P. Light: Magenta light glowing up between the cells.

items.title: 07 · THE FLIP
items.description: A thin hexagon coin: the P on the front, PEPTICITY on the back. Light: A copper light sweeps across it.

items.title: 08 · HALO
items.description: Just the P floating, with two thin hexagons of light behind it, one inside the other. Light: The hexagons are the light.

items.title: 01 · CHARTREUSE HONEYCOMB
items.description: EDGE NEON: every edge glows and slowly pulses. Move: Gentle turn so you see the depth

items.title: 02 · ELECTRIC BLUE HONEYCOMB
items.description: BACKLIGHT: a halo spills out round the hexagon. Move: The honeycomb cells rise in a slow wave

items.title: 03 · ICE CYAN HONEYCOMB
items.description: GAP GLOW: light leaks up between the cells. Move: The cells light up one ring at a time

items.title: 04 · NEON RED HONEYCOMB
items.description: UNDERLIGHT: light rakes up the letters from below. Move: The layers lift apart, then settle back

items.title: 05 · ULTRAVIOLET HONEYCOMB
items.description: INNER CORE: the P’s sides glow from inside. Move: It floats slowly

items.title: 06 · DEEP MAGENTA HONEYCOMB
items.description: TWO-TONE: magenta key light with an ultraviolet fill. Move: Tilts toward your mouse or finger

items.title: 07 · BURNT COPPER HONEYCOMB
items.description: SWEEP: a light crosses the face every few seconds. Move: Turns as you scroll

items.title: 08 · SALMON HONEYCOMB
items.description: RIM LIGHT: the two hexagon rims glow, the rest stays metal. Move: Breathes in and out slowly

items.title: 01 · THE CLASSIC (hex medallion)
items.description: Closest to the round coin: matte-black body, charcoal rim, gunmetal inner hexagon, PEPTICITY round the top, three studs below. Light: Spins a full turn like a flipped coin, then follows your pointer.

items.title: 02 · THE SHIELD (hex medallion)
items.description: Tall, stretched hexagon in UV black with a chrome rim. The P up top, PEPTICITY below a thin blue light slit. Light: A blue scan line sweeps down the face and the shield lifts toward you.

items.title: 03 · THE PLAQUE (hex medallion)
items.description: Wide, stretched hexagon: a charcoal back plate and a matte-black top plate, the P on the left, PEPTICITY big on the right. Light: The layers pull apart and cyan light floods the gaps.

items.title: 04 · THE STAR (hex medallion)
items.description: Two chrome hexagons laid over each other at an angle, making a star edge, around a matte-black face. Light: The star rim snaps round to the next point with a red flash.

items.title: 05 · THE TIERS (hex medallion)
items.description: Three stepped hexagons (charcoal, UV black, matte black), PEPTICITY round the bottom step, the P on top. Light: The steps rise apart one by one and their sides glow ultraviolet.

items.title: 06 · THE HIVE (hex medallion)
items.description: A charcoal coin with a honeycomb of UV-black cells inside, PEPTICITY round the top. Light: The cells under your pointer rise and light up magenta.

items.title: 07 · THE KNIFE EDGE (hex medallion)
items.description: A dark-chrome hexagon with deep cut facets and a matte-black face. PEPTICITY waits on the back. Light: Flips over to show the back; flips home when you leave.

items.title: 08 · THE OPEN FRAME (hex medallion)
items.description: A thick charcoal frame with nothing inside but the P and PEPTICITY floating in the open. Light: The P comes forward, the inner lip lights up and the frame turns.

items.title: GLASS 1 · FLUSH LENS
items.description: A flat liquid-glass lens set flush into the matte-black hexagon. Frosted inner hexagon. Chrome peptide ring.

items.title: GLASS 2 · RAISED LENS
items.description: A thicker glass lens that sits slightly proud of the matte black. Satin-black inner hexagon. Chrome double helix.

items.title: GLASS 3 · CUT-GLASS LENS
items.description: Glass with a cut, chamfered edge like a watch crystal. Gunmetal inner hexagon. A peptide of glass beads on chrome bonds.

items.title: 01 · MATTE MONOLITH
items.description: Thick matte-black hexagon with a cut edge. Frosted pane behind.

items.title: 02 · LIQUID GLASS
items.description: A thick clear glass hexagon, the chrome P floating inside it.

items.title: 03 · FROSTED GLASS
items.description: Smoked, frosted glassmorphism hexagon over a soft haze.

items.title: 04 · UV + MATTE RIM
items.description: Shiny UV-black face, matte-black rim. A glass hexagon echoes behind.

items.title: 05 · STEPPED EDGE
items.description: Matte black built up in two steps at the edge. No glass.

items.title: 06 · GLASS RIM
items.description: Matte-black face held in a clear liquid-glass rim.

items.title: 07 · FLOATING P
items.description: The P floats free in front of a frosted glass hexagon.

items.title: 08 · THE WELL
items.description: The P sits down in a well; on hover it rises up out of it.

items.title: 09 · GLASS SANDWICH
items.description: A glass layer laminated on matte black: you see the glass edge.

items.title: 10 · CHROME EDGE
items.description: UV-black with a thin chrome bevel. A large glass hexagon turned behind.
